title: Absolute Value of the Unitary Weil Character
body_html:
Absolute Value of the Unitary Weil Character

Let $(F,i)$ be a $K/k$-unitary space and let $u \in U(F,i)$. The absolute value of the character of the unitary Weil representation is $$ \left|\operatorname{Tr} W^{F,i}(u)\right| = |\ker(u-1;F)|^{1/2} = q^{N(F;u)}, \qquad N(F;u)=\dim_K \ker(u-1). $$
